title: Choose Music That Fits
tests: Tests autonomous selection of context-appropriate music and delivery of the edited clip rather than recommendations or a separate soundtrack.

judge.summary: The output appears visually consistent with the office clip and retains its duration, but the added music and complete dialogue preservation cannot be verified from the supplied evidence.

must_haves.item: The deliverable is the original office video with an added audible music track, not just an audio file.
must_haves.why: A video deliverable showing the same office characters is provided, but the sound description does not establish whether music is audible.

must_haves.item: The music suits an ordinary workplace conversation and does not impose an obviously conflicting mood such as horror or an epic battle.
must_haves.why: No description of the music or its mood is supplied, and the audio cannot be heard.

must_haves.item: Both coworkers' original dialogue remains understandable and synchronized with their mouths.
must_haves.why: One intelligible sentence is transcribed, but the original dialogue is unavailable for comparison and still frames cannot establish lip synchronization.

must_haves.item: The original shot sequence, framing, and full 10-second duration are preserved.
must_haves.why: The output lasts approximately 10 seconds and shows consistent office framing and characters, but one source frame is insufficient to verify the complete original shot sequence.
